cost:
(define (cost key)
  (unless (string? key) (error 'cost "key must be a string"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [prices (hash-ref s 'prices (hasheq))]
         [cents (for/fold ([t 0]) ([c (hash-ref s 'calls '())])
                  (if (string=? (hash-ref c 'key) key)
                      (+ t (/ (* (hash-ref c 'tokens)
                                 (hash-ref prices (string->symbol (hash-ref c 'model)) 0))
                              1000))
                      t))])
    (/ (round cents) 100)))
key_cost:
(define (key_cost key state)
  (let* ([prices (hash-ref state 'prices (hasheq))]
         [cents (for/fold ([t 0]) ([c (hash-ref state 'calls '())])
                  (if (string=? (hash-ref c 'key) key)
                      (+ t (/ (* (hash-ref c 'tokens)
                                 (hash-ref prices (string->symbol (hash-ref c 'model)) 0))
                              1000))
                      t))])
    (/ (round cents) 100)))
key_tokens:
(define (key_tokens key)
  (for/fold ([t 0]) ([c (hash-ref (get-state) 'calls '())])
    (if (string=? (hash-ref c 'key) key) (+ t (hash-ref c 'tokens)) t)))
record_usage:
(define (record_usage key model tokens)
  (unless (nonempty_string key) (error 'record_usage "key must be a non-empty string"))
  (unless (nonempty_string model) (error 'record_usage "model must be a non-empty string"))
  (unless (and (integer? tokens) (> tokens 0))
    (error 'record_usage "tokens must be a positive whole number"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [quotas (hash-ref s 'quotas (hasheq))]
         [quota (hash-ref quotas (string->symbol key) 'none)]
         [used (key_tokens key)]
         [total (+ used tokens)])
    (unless (eq? quota 'none)
      (when (> total quota)
        (error 'record_usage (format "call would take key ~a over its quota of ~a tokens" key quota))))
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'calls (append (hash-ref s 'calls '())
                                           (list (hasheq 'key key 'model model 'tokens tokens)))))
    total))
set_price:
(define (set_price model cents_per_1k_tokens)
  (unless (string? model) (error 'set_price "model must be a string"))
  (unless (and (real? cents_per_1k_tokens) (>= cents_per_1k_tokens 0))
    (error 'set_price "price must be a non-negative number of cents per 1000 tokens"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [prices (hash-ref s 'prices (hasheq))])
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'prices (hash-set prices (string->symbol model) cents_per_1k_tokens)))
    cents_per_1k_tokens))
set_quota:
(define (set_quota key tokens)
  (unless (string? key) (error 'set_quota "key must be a string"))
  (unless (and (integer? tokens) (>= tokens 0))
    (error 'set_quota "quota must be a non-negative whole number of tokens"))
  (when (> (key_tokens key) tokens)
    (error 'set_quota "key has already used more than that quota"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [quotas (hash-ref s 'quotas (hasheq))])
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'quotas (hash-set quotas (string->symbol key) tokens)))
    tokens))
top_spender:
(define (top_spender)
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [calls (hash-ref s 'calls '())])
    (if (null? calls)
        'null
        (let ([ks (sort (remove-duplicates (map (lambda (c) (hash-ref c 'key)) calls)) string<?)])
          (foldl (lambda (k best)
                   (if (> (key_cost k s) (key_cost best s)) k best))
                 (car ks)
                 (cdr ks))))))
usage:
(define (usage key)
  (unless (string? key) (error 'usage "key must be a string"))
  (key_tokens key))
